title: Barcode analysis for: Evolution of population bottleneck in symbiosis
description: Code for the barcode-sequencing analyses in Maeda et al., Evolution of population bottleneck in symbiosis: sample assignment, barcode counting, diversity and similarity measures, and the statistics reported in the figures. Raw sequencing reads are deposited in the NCBI Sequence Read Archive under BioProject PRJNA1551028.
